# `mise bootstrap macos launchd-agents status`

- **Usage:** `mise bootstrap macos launchd-agents status [-J --json] [--missing]`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/bootstrap.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/bootstrap.rs)

Show the state of the configured LaunchAgents

## Flags
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`--missing`** — Exit with status 1 if any LaunchAgent differs from the config (all are still listed)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
